basic_details.job_title: TMB Customer Service Executive Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Online registration for the Customer Service Executive (CSE) post at Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Ltd (TMB), a private-sector bank and not a government body, is open from 22 October 2026 to 31 October 2026 (23:59 IST). Graduates and postgraduates from a recognised university (regular curriculum) with a minimum 60% aggregate can apply. The maximum age is 26 years for graduates and 28 years for postgraduates as of 31 July 2026. The vacancies are for states other than Tamil Nadu and Puducherry, and candidates register on the TMB careers portal (careers.tmbankhr.com).

how_to_apply: Candidates apply by registering online on the TMB careers portal (careers.tmbankhr.com) between 22 October 2026 and 31 October 2026. Registration closes at 23:59 IST on 31 October 2026. The application fee is ₹590.00.
Open the CSE registration page from the "Register Now" link on the TMB careers portal.
If you have already registered, use the "Already Registered" link to log in.
Complete the registration before 23:59 IST on 31 October 2026.

For help with the application, call 044-40115245 (Calling time — 9:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m., Monday to Sunday). You can also write to [email protected] with all relevant information from your registered email id.

content_sections.heading: About TMB
content_sections.text: Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Ltd (TMB), with the tagline "Be a step ahead in life", is a private-sector bank. It is headquartered in Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu. TMB runs this recruitment through its careers portal, careers.tmbankhr.com, where the recruitment is listed as "TMB Recruitment 2026".

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice sets the following eligibility for the Customer Service Executive (CSE) post: Educational qualification: Any Graduate / Postgraduate, regular curriculum, recognised university. Minimum marks: Minimum 60% aggregate. Experience: Experience preferable, not mandatory. Age limit: Max age 26 (Graduate) / 28 (Postgraduate) as of 31 July 2026. The notice does not print a minimum age. State of posting: The vacancies are available for the states other than Tamil Nadu and Puducherry.
